answers.reason: The president chairs the central bodies of the university, which includes the senate.
The budget planning round is a central body dealing with university funds, which falls under leadership and central administration.
Appointment committees select candidates for professorships, which is not part of the president's stated central duties.
The faculty council decides on the affairs of one faculty, led by its dean, not the university president.
The study commission operates at the faculty level to advise the faculty council.
The examination board handles examination matters at the faculty or individual level.
The internal research funding round awards small faculty-level grants.
The module revision working group operates at the degree programme level within a faculty.
Laboratory equipment procurement is a specific faculty-level or departmental task.
Orientation week planning is organized for new students at the faculty level.
